note: Higgsfield generations behind every photo and video on the page. `npm run assets:fetch` downloads them to .cache/raw/; images.mjs / media.mjs turn them into src/assets and public/media.

assets.name: hero-a
assets.prompt: Wide cinematic establishing photograph of a prestigious Korean university campus in late autumn at golden hour. A grand neoclassical granite main hall with a slender central clock tower and a six-column portico stands at the end of a long, wide pedestrian boulevard lined on both sides with brilliant yellow ginkgo trees. Fallen golden ginkgo leaves cover the pale stone pavement. Small groups of university students in autumn coats and scarves walk and chat, some carrying books and tote bags. Soft low sun from the left casting long warm shadows, gentle atmospheric haze, forested blue-green hills of Seoul in the distance behind the building, clear soft sky. Composition: main hall slightly right of center, calmer open sky and tree canopy on the left third. Elevated drone viewpoint about 15 meters high, 35mm lens, natural documentary color grading, crisp architectural detail, high dynamic range, photorealistic. Absolutely no text, no signage, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

assets.name: campus-map
assets.prompt: Isometric illustrated map of a fictional Korean university campus, clean modern vector illustration with soft shading and subtle texture, calm palette of deep navy, sky blue, warm stone beige, soft green and ginkgo yellow on an off-white background. Center: a neoclassical stone main hall with a clock tower facing a circular plaza with a fountain. Around it, clearly separated with space between them: a modern glass library building on the left, two engineering and AI research buildings at the upper right, a student union and cafeteria with an outdoor terrace at the lower right, three dormitory towers at the upper left, a gymnasium beside a red running track and green soccer field at the far right, a main gate at the bottom center opening onto a long boulevard lined with yellow ginkgo trees, and a small pond with a traditional Korean pavilion at the lower left. Light grey paths connect every building, tiny students walking. Whole campus fits in frame with generous margins. Completely free of any text, labels, letters, numbers, signs or logos.
